answer:
Pending on you: whether to change Caw's context handling because of cold-wake cost.

Numbers: Caw's conversation is 5.2 MB. Each wake costs about $5.09. Over 24h Caw cost $39.96, and $25.67 of that (64%) came from cold wakes, which re-read the whole conversation. The default model is claude-opus-5-5[1m], and no size rule exists in the code.

Options:
1) 200k window (recommended)
2) Cheap-model summary rollover
3) Leave it

Caveat: any change alters Caw's memory, so it's your call. A model change also ends the lead session (modelAfter, plan/caw.ts).
